bug_info.bug_desc: The otp_size_o ternary in otp_ctrl_part_unbuf selects the OTP read size with inverted branches. When otp_addr_sel == DigestAddr it requests a 32-bit read, but the spec requires digest reads to use the full OTP block size. When otp_addr_sel == DataAddr it requests the full block size, but data reads must be 32-bit. This causes incorrect OTP read sizes for both digest initialization and normal bus read transactions.
bug_info.fix_hint: Swap the two otp_size_o expressions so that the DigestAddr case uses OtpSizeWidth'(unsigned'(ScrmblBlockWidth / OtpWidth - 1)) and the DataAddr case uses OtpSizeWidth'(unsigned'(32 / OtpWidth - 1)). This makes digest reads use the full OTP block size and data reads use the 32-bit word size as required.
